final: WITH per_product AS (SELECT p.product_id, pc.product_type_description AS d, AVG(CAST(oi.product_quantity AS REAL)) AS aq, COUNT(oi.order_item_id) AS c FROM Products p JOIN Product_Categories pc ON pc.production_type_code = p.production_type_code LEFT JOIN Order_Items oi ON oi.product_id = p.product_id GROUP BY p.product_id, pc.product_type_description), tot AS (SELECT SUM(c) AS t FROM per_product), per_type AS (SELECT d, AVG(aq) AS aq, AVG(c) AS ac, AVG(c * 1.0 / (SELECT t FROM tot)) AS ash FROM per_product GROUP BY d) SELECT AVG(aq) AS avg_quantity, AVG(ac) AS avg_order_item_count, AVG(ash) AS avg_share FROM per_type
